title: Trident Conjuring
description: Thrown Trident stay in hand Enchantment.
body:
# Trident Conjuring


## Notice
Loading this triggers experimental settings warning.


## Description
New enchantment **Conjuring** for trident.

This enchantment prevents trident from leaving hand when thrown.

Mechanic similar to _Drowned with trident_.


## Features
Allows for repeated and rapid throwing of trident from same hand slot.

Allows for safe throwing of trident near portals and voids.


## Details
- Can be obtained from anvil, trade, and loot.
- Works with main-hand and off-hand slots.
- Incompatible with Riptide and Loyalty.
- In creative mode does nothing.


## Limitations
Since this actually returns trident to right hand slot
instead of keeping it there, it can misbehave if it gets interrupted.

1. This can fail to trigger when a player hand slots somehow change
   between releasing right click and trident spawning.

2. This can hand over trident to other player when he somehow
   gets closer to spawned trident when effect triggers.

But those cases are unrealistic for a normal gameplay.
